svg.text: For the Open Innovation theme, Contour draws your day as a topographic map: every active hour raises the land, so a
morning run becomes a tall peak and a quiet afternoon stays flat, with the highest point marked by a glowing pin. The
time floats in light type over the contour lines, and a swipe turns the map into an elevation profile of the whole
day. Always-on keeps a few faint grey contour lines under the time.

g.text: Higher land means a busier hour

svg.text: 368 × 448 rectangular OLED · text ≥ 21 px · icons ≥ 25 px · always-on on true black · all names fictional, no logos · Designed by Amritha S
